blind_spots: This research pass did not deeply mine WebGPU, browser, or mobile-CPU implementation literature, which may dominate a real minimal simulator deployment.
The pass stayed close to simulation and numerics papers; it did not fully explore HCI or education studies on what makes orbital behavior understandable to novices.
Relativistic, non-Newtonian, and constrained-body cases were treated as out of scope, which may be wrong if the user means gravity in a broader pedagogical sense.
Differentiable calibration ideas may become brittle at mode switches unless encounter triggers are smoothed or relaxed.
Resolution-coupled softening improves honesty, but it could also confuse users if the UI does not clearly distinguish numerical blur from real physics.
The prior-art watchlist is noisy, so there may be unsurfaced educational simulators or game-engine notes outside academic indices that deserve a second pass.

anomaly_results.constraint: Must run at 60 fps on a phone CPU.
anomaly_results.result: Global O(N^2) dies quickly; neighbor_tree_gravity, angular_sweep_encounter_queue, and event_sparse_far_field move from optional ideas to structural requirements.

anomaly_results.constraint: No square roots allowed in the inner loop.
anomaly_results.result: The design shifts toward inverse-distance approximations, cached rsqrt paths, epicycle patches, and aggressive near/far decomposition instead of naive pairwise force code.

anomaly_results.constraint: Users can inject million-to-one mass ratios live.
anomaly_results.result: Fixed dt becomes fragile; encounter_reversible_substeps and forward_reverse_verification_loop become the safety spine, not nice-to-have add-ons.

anomaly_results.constraint: The simulator must be explainable to middle-school students.
anomaly_results.result: Constraint projection, explicit trust metrics, and fit-from-trail workflows become more valuable than squeezing out another layer of invisible raw accuracy.

anomaly_results.constraint: The scene is a narrow ring instead of free space.
anomaly_results.result: Epicycle patches and angular sweeps dominate the architecture, while a generic global tree is no longer the central organizing principle.
